title: Number-Rhyme Pegs
short: Each number from 1 to 10 has a peg word that rhymes with it: one-bun, two-shoe, three-tree, and so on.
trouble: Mixing up pegs that sound alike in your own list. Fix one list and stick with it.

practice.q: Hang a short list on the rhyme pegs: 1 milk, 2 stamps, 3 batteries.
steps: 1 bun: a bun soaking in a puddle of milk.
2 shoe: a shoe covered in stamps.
3 tree: a tree with batteries hanging like fruit.
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: The oldest and easiest pegs rhyme with their numbers. This is a common list; you may change a peg if another rhyme is easier for you to picture, but then keep it.
Say the number, hear the rhyme, see the picture. Then link the item to the picture.

blocks.title: Worked example
blocks.q: Hang a short list on the rhyme pegs: 1 milk, 2 stamps, 3 batteries.
steps: 1 bun: a bun soaking in a puddle of milk.
2 shoe: a shoe covered in stamps.
3 tree: a tree with batteries hanging like fruit.

blocks.html: Rhyme makes the peg come back with no effort, which is what a peg must do.
